run_UR5_ee_xyz_control: run the UR5 robot arm end effector XYZ displacement control example script
create_Robot_ur5_arm: create a Robot instance for a UR5 arm with arm enabled and other components disabled
move_ee_xyz_displacement: move the robot arm end effector along x, y, or z axis by a specified displacement vector
get_joint_angles: get and print the current joint angles of the UR5 robot arm
move_arm_to_neutral: move the UR5 robot arm to its neutral starting position before executing movements
